Sacrifice them at the beginning of the next end step. Activate only as a sorcery." ActivatedAbility.fromGraveyard already gives graveyard activation (legal.ts:225), but the self-exile half of the cost has no field - AbilityCost.exileFromGraveyard exiles OTHER cards (game.ts:667, others(pl.graveyard)) - so the ability would be infinitely repeatable, and token-copy.attacking has no per-opponent form.
